description:
Create an unlabeled association between two HubSpot objects (v3 API).

For labeled associations (e.g., "Primary Contact", "Contract Signatory", "Decision Maker"),
use create_hubspot_labeled_association instead.

Common association types:
- contact_to_company
- deal_to_contact
- deal_to_company
- ticket_to_contact
- line_item_to_deal

fromObjectType.description: Source object type. Common values: "contacts", "companies", "deals", "tickets", "leads", "products", "line_items", or any custom object name.

toObjectType.description: Target object type. Common values: "contacts", "companies", "deals", "tickets", "leads", "products", "line_items", or any custom object name.

name: create_hubspot_association
